name: Swale on contour (from elevation), spillway south
notes: Suggested: set out the level line on site with an A-frame after a wet season of watching. From the 5 m elevation the level line here is about 119 m and runs north–south between the house and cabin. The bench sits on a spur, so only about 0.1 ha drains to it: the boggy patch is more likely seepage or poorly draining clay. Spill at the south end into the rain garden, never toward the house.
source: Review suggestion (Firefly Farm design review, 23 Oct 2026)
